context: A uni student debates a teacher on community issues
purpose: Teach: 増税/喪失/上陸/遺体/寺院/決着/住人/渡り

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 先生、今度の増税には正直納得できません。学生にとっては本当に痛いです。
lines.en: Professor, honestly I can't accept this tax hike. For students, it really hurts.
lines.style: Frustrated but respectful, pushing back firmly against authority

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 気持ちは分かるけど、町の住人の高齢化も考えないと、社会保障が成り立たないのよ。
lines.en: I understand how you feel, but considering the aging residents of the town, social welfare can't function otherwise.
lines.style: Calm, measured teacher tone laying out the bigger picture

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: でも先週、台風が上陸した時も、避難所の対応がひどかったじゃないですか。税金、ちゃんと使われてます?
lines.en: But last week when the typhoon made landfall, the shelter response was terrible. Is our tax money really being used properly?
lines.style: Sharp, challenging, citing concrete recent example as evidence

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 確かにあの時、山の方で遺体が見つかった事故もあったわね。行政の責任は重いわ。
lines.en: True, around that time there was also that incident where a body was found in the mountains. The government bears heavy responsibility.
lines.style: Acknowledging a painful point, voice softening with somber agreement

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: そうですよ。なのに古い寺院の修繕には予算がつくのに、若者の生活支援は後回し。信頼の喪失ですよ。
lines.en: Exactly. Yet budgets get approved for old temple repairs, but support for young people's lives is always last. It's a loss of trust.
lines.style: Building momentum, indignant, listing grievances with rising heat

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 渡り廊下の修理一つにも色々な事情があるの。ただ、あなたの怒りは正しいと思う。
lines.en: Even repairing one connecting corridor involves all sorts of circumstances. But your anger, I think, is justified.
lines.style: Gentle pushback paired with genuine validation of the student

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: この議論、簡単には決着がつかないですね。でも、声を上げ続けないと変わらないですよね。
lines.en: This debate won't easily reach a conclusion, will it. But unless we keep raising our voices, nothing changes, right?
lines.style: Cooling down, reflective, looking for shared ground with mentor

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: その通り。今度のゼミでこのテーマ、皆で議論しましょう。あなたが口火を切ってちょうだい。
lines.en: Exactly. Let's discuss this theme together in the next seminar. You take the lead in starting it.
lines.style: Encouraging, warm teacher voice handing responsibility back to student
